name: works-on-my-codex
description: Keep a thin, project-specific Codex harness current.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a thin, project-specific Codex harness current.
interface.longDescription: WOMC creates and refreshes a thin project harness when contextual reading routes, non-native skills, workspaces, or validation commands change. It avoids reacting to ordinary document edits or duplicating natively discovered skill descriptions. Its trusted session hook performs only a read-only harness check and never changes personal Codex UI settings.
defaultPrompt: Set up a Works on My Codex harness in this project.
